blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — The municipal government of El Nido has sent a team to Coron to coordinate with authorities and assist families affected by the MV June Aster maritime tragedy. The El Nido Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) said Tuesday (Sept. 15) that it was extending its condolences and support to the families and loved ones of the passengers and crew involved in the incident. Acting on the directive of Mayor Edna Gacot-Lim, the municipality dispatched MDRRMO representative Raymond Osorio, Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) representative Eymard Fulgencio, and Municipal Gender and Development representative Jan Gibb […]...
